follow-up time: 7 days during the second trimester of pregnancy
exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal vs. caesarean section)
physical activity (PA) during early second trimester of pregnancy
outcome: Umbilical cord arterial and venous blood gas (pH, partial pressure of carbon dioxide and oxygen, and oxygen saturation)
Duration of first stage of labor
cohort: 94 Caucasian pregnant women (mean age 32.9 ± 4.6 years old)
finding: Greater sedentary time during early second trimester of pregnancy was associated with higher umbilical cord blood partial pressure of carbon dioxide and more acidic arterial and venous pH, while moderate physical activity was positively associated with arterial cord blood oxygen saturation.
mod_finding: No significant differences were observed in sedentary time and physical activity levels between women with vaginal and women with caesarean section deliveries.
